generate_random_string: generate a random autotrain project name string with the format autotrain-xxxxx-xxxxx
colab_app: launch an ipywidgets UI for configuring and starting autotrain model training in Google Colab
update_col_mapping: update the column mapping widget based on the selected ML task type
update_parameters: update the training parameters JSON based on the selected task and parameter preset
start_training: start model training by writing a config YAML and running the autotrain CLI command
